FAQ

Packaging & Label Design: FAQs

Do you provide dielines?

I can work with your manufacturer's dieline or create one for standard box styles, then place artwork accurately with bleeds and safe zones.

Can you design packaging for export?

Yes. I design multilingual packaging and follow labelling conventions for markets such as the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK, the EU and the US. Final regulatory compliance should always be confirmed with your compliance team.

Will I see my packaging before printing?

Yes. You receive realistic 3D mockups and can request a physical proof from your printer before mass production.
